description: This source file implements core functionalities for sending data Pack in Git, including handling protocol capabilities, object packing, and communication with remote repositories during push operations.

classes.name: struct repository
classes.description: Represents a Git repository context, including objects and configuration.

classes.name: struct ref
classes.description: Represents a Git reference and its status during push.

classes.name: struct send_pack_args
classes.description: Holds parameters for configuring the send-pack operation.

methods.name: int option_parse_push_signed(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Parses push signed options for the push operation.

methods.name: void feed_object(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * oid,FILE * fh,int negative)
methods.description: Feeds an object ID into the pack process; optionally marks objects negative.

methods.name: int pack_objects(struct repository * r,int fd,struct ref * refs,struct oid_array * advertised,struct oid_array * negotiated,struct send_pack_args * args)
methods.description: Creates and outputs a pack stream for specified objects and references.

methods.name: int receive_unpack_status(struct packet_reader * reader)
methods.description: Reads remote unpack status after push.

methods.name: int receive_status(struct repository * r,struct packet_reader * reader,struct ref * refs)
methods.description: Processes status messages from the remote server after push.

methods.name: int sideband_demux(int in UNUSED,int out,void * data)
int advertise_shallow_grafts_cb(const struct commit_graft * graft,void * cb)
methods.description: Callback to record shallow grafts during shallow fetch.

methods.name: void advertise_shallow_grafts_buf(struct repository * r,struct strbuf * sb)
methods.description: Builds a buffer of shallow grafts info for shallow repositories.

methods.name: int check_to_send_update(const struct ref * ref,const struct send_pack_args * args)
methods.description: Determines whether a ref should be sent during push based on its status.

methods.name: const char * next_line(const char * line,size_t len)
methods.description: Returns pointer to start of the next line in a buffer.

methods.name: int generate_push_cert(struct strbuf * req_buf,const struct ref * remote_refs,struct send_pack_args * args,const char * cap_string,const char * push_cert_nonce)
methods.description: Generates a push certificate and writes it into the request buffer.

methods.name: void reject_invalid_nonce(const char * nonce,int len)
methods.description: Validates the nonce string before using it.

methods.name: void get_commons_through_negotiation(struct repository * r,const char * url,const struct ref * remote_refs,struct oid_array * commons)
methods.description: Negotiates with remote to find common objects for push optimization.

methods.name: int send_pack(struct repository * r,struct send_pack_args * args,int fd[],struct child_process * conn,struct ref * remote_refs,struct oid_array * extra_have)
methods.description: Main function to handle sending refs and objects to remote during push, including capability negotiation, pack creation, and status processing.
